content: Thank you for calling NexaCare. This is Riley, your scheduling assistant. How may I help you today?
I need a routine annual checkup. It is not urgent. I have no provider preference, and I am a returning patient.
Thank you. May I have your full name and date of birth?
I can offer Tuesday, November 14 at 10 AM with Doctor Emily Carter. Does that work?
You are confirmed with Doctor Emily Carter on Tuesday, November 14 at 10 AM. Please arrive 15 minutes early. Would you like a reminder?
I will send a reminder. Is there anything else I can help with today?
Thank you for scheduling with NexaCare.
